messages:
Jason (Customer): Getting 403 on /v1/embeddings — I used the same API key that works for completions. Started ~today after we onboarded a few new users. Can you check?

Sarah (Support): sorry about that — can you paste the exact curl + response body? 403 usually means auth but could be entitlement.

Jason (Customer): sure — here's the request I sent:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/embeddings \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_live_ABC123' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"model":"embed-2025-002","input":"convert this to vec"}'
```
and response: 
```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": 403,
    "message": "Access denied",
    "type": "forbidden"
  }
}
```

Jason (Customer): I can call /v1/completions fine with same key. It feels like a permissions or billing thing but error is just 403.

Sarah (Support): thanks. Picking this up — SUP-3421. I'm going to repro on my side with the key (with customer consent) and check the account's plan/entitlements.

Sarah (Support): quick repro notes — I swapped the model to text-generation and the key works. When targeting embeddings model I get the same 403. Header looks identical.

Sarah (Support): @Alex (Billing) can you confirm whether embed-2025-002 is gated by plan or feature flag for Jason's org (org_id: org_78ZX)?

Alex (Billing): looked at org_78ZX — they're on Free tier (trial expired). We rolled out embed-v2 behind 'pro' flag in 2025-11 rollout. Their billing profile doesn't include that entitlement. Currently the platform returns 403 for gated features.

Sarah (Support): ah — so this is entitlement gating, not an API key auth failure. Jason — sorry for the opaque error. You were right to suspect billing.

Jason (Customer): ok that explains it. Is there a way to get a short trial or enable embed-2025-002 for our org? We need it for a client POC starting Monday.

Alex (Billing): I can enable a 7-day trial entitlement for embed-v2 for org_78ZX manually. Doing it now, will post when active.

webhook-bot: entitlement.change - org_78ZX - feature: embed-v2 - actor: Alex (Billing) - status: enabled - ts: 1760002300

Alex (Billing): trial enabled. Please retry in ~30s to allow cache propagation. Ticket SUP-3421 updated.

Jason (Customer): tried again — still 403.

Nate (Eng): pinged — n7. Repro locally with org_78ZX — I can see a discrepancy: gate checks set an error code 'entitlement_required' in the internal flow but the user-facing serializer strips the code and only returns generic 403/forbidden. That's why it looked like auth.

Nate (Eng): minimal log snippet (internal):
```
[auth] request=evt-9a8b model=embed-2025-002 org=org_78ZX result=entitlement_required
[serializer] -> http 403 : message "Access denied" (code removed)
```

Nate (Eng): filing ENG-1198 — will patch serializer to surface an error.type = "entitlement_required" and message that points to plan/upgrade docs. Rolling a small fix to staging now.

Priya (SRE): also recommend emitting a metric `entitlement.denied` with org tag so billing/product can report frequent false-positives and iterate on gating UX.

Sarah (Support): Nate — timeline? This is impacting a POC. Can we short-term document the behavior so support can tell customers it's billing-related and not malformed key?

Nate (Eng): short-term: will add a temporary response field in the next 30m on staging and 2h to prod, plus automated test. Long-term: change SDK to map to EntitlementError and docs update. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/eng/pull/821 (WIP).

Alex (Billing): FYI — I'll add a note to the billing runbook to flag gated features that return 403 vs 402/upgrade. We should be consistent.

Sarah (Support): Jason — once Nate confirms prod deploy, I'll ask you to retry. Meanwhile I'll keep the trial on.

webhook-bot: deploy - eng - pr821 - staging - status: success - ts: 1760003000

Nate (Eng): staging patch pushed. sample staging response: 
```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": 403,
    "message": "Entitlement required: embed-v2. Upgrade your plan or request trial.",
    "type": "entitlement_required",
    "meta": { "feature": "embed-v2", "docs": "https://docs.redwood.example/entitlements#embed-v2" }
  }
}
```

Jason (Customer): staging response looks great. Can you push to prod?

Nate (Eng): will promote in 1h window — low risk change. Monitoring to watch for alerts on 403 spike.

webhook-bot: deploy - eng - pr821 - prod - status: success - ts: 1760004200

Jason (Customer): retested now against prod — success! embeddings returned. thank you everyone. :tada:

Sarah (Support): awesome — closing SUP-3421 as resolved after customer confirmation. Open follow-ups: ENG-1198 (serializer fix/permanent), DOCS-577 (clarify error codes & entitlement page), BILL-423 (billing runbook update).

Priya (SRE): added alert rule: if entitlement.denied rate > 0.5% of auth failures in 1h, notify product & billing.

Alex (Billing): leaving note on org_78ZX: trial enabled + annotation so we do not auto-cancel.

Jason (Customer): appreciate the fast turnaround. Please do consider clearer initial error text — it saved us time to have staging sample.

Sarah (Support): agreed. We'll follow up once ENG-1198 lands. Marking thread resolved. :white_check_mark:
